name: git-statusline
description: A mod that draws a git line under the prompt: repo path, branch, linked-worktree marker, ahead/behind with colour past unpushed-commit thresholds, staged/modified/new/conflict counts, changed lines and stash count.

push_warning_threshold.title: Unpushed commits: warning
push_warning_threshold.description: Colour the ahead count amber at this many unpushed commits. 0 turns it off.

push_critical_threshold.title: Unpushed commits: critical
push_critical_threshold.description: Colour the ahead count red at this many unpushed commits. 0 turns it off.
